eden-engine.title: The Eden Engine
eden-engine.lede: The Eden Engine is Frostrail's armored steam locomotive: transport, heat source, power plant, workshop, storage base, and the shared objective the Penitent Gardeners must keep alive.
eden-engine.imageAlt: Operating the Eden Engine from the locomotive cab

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Frostrail is built around operating an armored train through the frozen remains of an empire. The crew fuels, powers, drives, maintains, expands, and defends the locomotive while using it as the base between expeditions.
The Steam description names the locomotive the Eden Engine. Developer interviews describe its destruction or breakdown as the run's central fail state.
bullets: Travel between frozen levels
Provide heat and power
Host crafting, refining, repair, cooking, weapon, and storage facilities
Carry the party's upgrades and progression

sections.title: Operation
paragraphs: Operating the Eden Engine connects resource gathering to survival. Fuel sustains movement and heat, power supports onboard systems, and repairs or reinforcement keep the train functional under environmental and enemy pressure.
A PC Gamer developer interview says engine upgrades affect train speed and pulling weight. Adding more carriages therefore creates a power tradeoff rather than free capacity.

sections.title: Place in the story
paragraphs: Players are Penitent Gardeners traveling north through an empire frozen after its Emperor made a pact with the Void. The train is both their shelter and their means of continuing that pilgrimage.
bullets: Former empire frozen by a Void-linked pact
Revenants and eldritch horrors inhabit the wasteland
The crew seeks salvation in the north

sections.title: Unconfirmed data
paragraphs: No final engine health, speed, acceleration, fuel capacity, power output, heat radius, crew-control layout, repair cost, or upgrade tree has been published.

sections.title: Upgrade progression
paragraphs: Recovered materials are reinvested in the train, turning exploration into persistent capability. Public materials confirm the direction of this loop but do not publish a final tech tree or optimal order.

Engine upgrades can improve speed and the weight the locomotive can pull. Because extra carriages demand more power, expansion is presented as an operating tradeoff rather than a purely cosmetic upgrade.
bullets: Protect the locomotive
Expand production and storage
Balance extra carriages against power demand
Improve speed and pulling capacity
Prepare for train-defense encounters

sections.title: Early Access scope
paragraphs: The Steam Early Access statement says the core loop is available in the initial scope and the full version is planned to add more train upgrades, alongside more locations, dungeons, loot, weapons, and co-op situations.

sections.title: Data awaiting verification
paragraphs: Upgrade names, prerequisites, material costs, build times, placement limits, durability, power consumption, unlock conditions, and final balance values remain TBA.

carriages.title: Frostrail Carriages
carriages.lede: Additional carriages expand the Eden Engine into a larger mobile base with room for crafting facilities, storage, reinforcement, and crew functions.
carriages.imageAlt: Frostrail train carriages moving through the frozen tundra

sections.title: Carriage expansion
paragraphs: The official store description says players can add carriages, crafting stations, and storage to build the train into a mobile base. This is a progression system, not merely visual customization.

Developer interviews add two constraints: walls use grid-snapped construction, and more carriages require more engine power because upgrades govern speed and pulling weight. The team does not expect extreme multi-storey structures.
bullets: Increase usable train space
Host production facilities
Add storage
Build walls on a snapped grid
Balance train length against power and pulling capacity

sections.title: Carriage facilities
paragraphs: Confirmed facility categories include crafting benches, refineries, weapon modification, repair, cooking, and storage. Public sources do not yet map these facilities to named carriage classes.

sections.title: Unconfirmed fields
paragraphs: Carriage names, dimensions, attachment points, build costs, power draw, mass, durability, maximum train length, placement restrictions, and unlock progression remain TBA.

fuel.title: Frostrail Fuel
fuel.lede: Fuel keeps the Eden Engine moving and warm. Branches, logs, and charcoal are the three fuel inputs publicly named by FakeFish founder Aku Jauhiainen.

sections.title: Fuel loop
paragraphs: Scavenging decisions feed directly into the train's ability to move and protect the crew from the cold. Fuel and power are related operating systems, but the public information does not yet expose a complete simulation model.
bullets: Recover or produce fuel
Load it into the Eden Engine
Maintain movement and heat
Plan reserves before entering a new level

sections.title: Unconfirmed fuel data
paragraphs: The developers have not published node locations, gathering tools, processing recipes, fuel-slot capacity, burn duration, heat output, travel distance per unit, quality tiers, or relative efficiency.

power.title: Frostrail Power
power.lede: The crew must power the Eden Engine and its onboard systems while managing the resources that keep the mobile base functional and warm.
power.imageAlt: Powered machinery aboard the Frostrail train

sections.title: Power system
paragraphs: Official copy explicitly tells players to fuel, power, and operate the Eden Engine. Power supports the train's function as a base, but the developers have not yet shown a complete electrical network or consumer list.
bullets: Keep the locomotive operational
Support onboard stations and train functions
Balance power with fuel, heat, repair, and defense

sections.title: Confirmed system links
paragraphs: The train hosts crafting facilities, refineries, storage, repair, cooking, and weapon systems. It is reasonable to identify these as onboard systems, but their individual power draw is not yet public and is therefore not asserted.

sections.title: Unconfirmed fields
paragraphs: Generation rate, grid capacity, power priorities, outages, battery storage, facility consumption, cable or connection mechanics, user interface, upgrade effects, and failure thresholds remain TBA.

defense.title: Frostrail Train Defense
defense.lede: Train-defense encounters are part of the current development plan, combining attacks on the Eden Engine with obstacle-clearing and, according to developer interviews, potential mounted machine guns and cannons.
defense.imageAlt: Frostrail crew defending a train carriage from attacking enemies

sections.title: Defense encounters
paragraphs: The May 2026 update says train-defense encounters are being integrated with gameplay around clearing obstacles from the route. A founder interview also describes planned waves of Revenants and mounting machine guns or cannons to protect the locomotive.
bullets: Protect the Eden Engine
Respond to attacks around the train
Clear route obstacles
Use structural reinforcement and planned weapon systems

sections.title: Failure condition
paragraphs: The Eden Engine is the crew's shared lifeline. Developer interviews state that if it breaks or is destroyed, the game ends. Exact repair windows, recoverable states, health values, and co-op revive interactions are not public.

sections.title: Mounted weapons
paragraphs: Machine guns and cannons have been discussed as possible mounted train defenses. Treat these as direct developer plans rather than guaranteed Early Access loadout details.

sections.title: Preparation checklist
paragraphs: Until a playable build supplies exact systems, reliable preparation advice is limited to the confirmed dependencies.
bullets: Keep the Eden Engine fueled and operational
Reinforce the train as upgrade systems allow
Maintain weapons and repair capacity
Expect enemy behavior and balance to change before Early Access
